ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized on the lateral lobe surfaces and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated around the median notch and lower lobe boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions occupy the outer two-thirds of both lobes. A central low-intensity black region radiates from the notch. Multiple discrete circular low-intensity focal spots are mapped on the white fields: three distinct spots on the left lobe and one prominent spot on the upper right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes reaching up to 15 pixels in depth, most aggressive towards the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Compound curvature exhibiting a slight concavity at the notch exit transitioning into a broad, sweeping convexity towards the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, multi-tonal circular pixel formations (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical low-intensity linear disruption (rake mark) on the lower-left lobe; several smaller, faint diagonal linear disruptions on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at both distal tips; distinct vertical scar on the left lobe; multiple circular puncture-type scars across the ventral white surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly defined, isolated circular black spot located in the upper-right quadrant of the white pigmentation area on the right lobe.
